Sri Lanka, who had resumed at 309-9, added seven runs before Asitha Fernando was trapped lbw for two by Abbas.

stories.title: Pakistan calls for ‘universal realisation’ of right to self-determination
stories.brief: Pakistan called for the “universal realisation” of the right to self-determination, saying the aspirations of people living under foreign occupation remained unfulfilled despite the principle being enshrined in international law.

stories.title: US religious freedom panel says India is targeting Muslims in voter roll revisions
stories.brief: India has escalated its targeting of religious minorities ​during a voter list revision that struck off tens of millions of names nationwide, a US panel ‌on religious freedom said on Thursday. India's voter list revision removed ​130 million names, roughly the population of Mexico, in the largest deletion of voters in the country's ​history.

stories.title: Pakistan conquer Sri Lanka to seal Test series
stories.brief: Pakistan on Friday sealed the two-match Test series against Sri Lanka 1-0 when they conquered the visitors by eight wickets on the fourth day of the second and final Test at the Pindi Stadium in Rawalpindi. Sri Lanka had scored 98 in their first innings while in response Pakistan had piled-up 325.

stories.title: Pakistan calls Houthi attack on Riyadh tower ‘grave violation’ of Saudi sovereignty
stories.brief: Pakistan on Friday condemned a Houthi attack on a tower in Riyadh's King Abdullah Financial District (KAFD), calling it a “grave violation” of Saudi Arabia's sovereignty and urging an immediate halt to such attacks.
